provide technical advisory services, analytical work, facilitation and capacity development in response to emerging needs, without the lead time of individual ad hoc procurements. The contractor will establish and operate this pool, ensuring the timely identification, mobilisation and quality assurance of experts assigned to specific requests from GIZ, covering regional cooperation on trade, investment and employment; digital and telecommunications regulation; digital skills; and cybersecurity. The contractor shall establish and operate a STEP capable of rapidly assessing and responding to technical support requests from GIZ; identifying, mobilising and managing qualified short-term experts; delivering high-quality, results-oriented technical assistance, analytical work and capacity development; and ensuring quality assurance, knowledge management and reporting in accordance with GIZ standards. Individual assignments will be commissioned by GIZ on a rolling basis according to programme priorities and emerging needs, and may take place remotely or on-site, primarily in the countries of the EU Southern Neighbourhood, EU Member States and other locations relevant to programme implementation. Work is organised into four interrelated Work Packages: Work Package 1 - Regional cooperation on Trade, Investment and Employment: technical expertise on regional economic integration, employment and private sector development, including trade facilitation, investment climate reforms, competition policy, sustainable value chains, SME competitiveness, employment promotion, and Union for the Mediterranean processes and initiatives. Work Package 2 - Digital and Telecommunications Regulation: technical expertise on telecommunications and electronic communications regulation, digital governance, data governance and Digital Public Infrastructure, AI governance, and regional regulatory cooperation, in particular through the Euro-Mediterranean Regulators Group (EMERG), delivered across three thematic clusters - Economic/Market Regulation; Technical/Spectrum & Infrastructure Regulation; and Legal & Digital Regulatory Affairs - as short-term, on-demand surge capacity complementing the programme's dedicated Regulatory Consultancy contract. Work Package 3 - Digital Skills: support to national digital skills strategies, demand assessments, competence and qualification frameworks, skills recognition and comparability, and regional cooperation and peer learning on digital skills for MSMEs and business support organisations. Work Package 4 - Cyber Security: support to national cybersecurity strategies and regulation, alignment with international standards (e.g. NIS-2, NIST, ISO), technical and organisational development of incident response organisations (CSIRTs/CERTs), capacity development, information sharing and cyber diplomacy. Across all Work Packages, indicative services include: technical advisory services to governments, regulatory authorities and regional organisations; regulatory, institutional and policy assessments and analytical studies; development of policy recommendations, strategies and action plans; capacity development through coaching, training and training-of-trainers formats; design and facilitation of workshops, expert meetings and regional exchange formats; organisational development and institutional strengthening of partner organisations and regional networks; stakeholder engagement and multi-stakeholder dialogue; and development of technical guidance, methodologies, toolkits and knowledge products. The contractor's team comprises a Team Leader / Pool Manager (key expert) with overall responsibility for the advisory package and day-to-day coordination with GIZ; a Senior Short-Term Expert Pool of 8 up to 10 experts covering international trade and investment, telecommunications and digital regulation, digital skills, institutional development, regional policy dialogue and cybersecurity, who lead complex technical advisory assignments; and a Junior Short-Term Expert Pool of 8 experts providing analytical and delivery support across the same thematic areas. The contractor is responsible for the selection, preparation and steering of all experts, and for proposing at least two suitable candidates per assignment request within three working days. Title: Germany – Load-bearing structure design services – Tragwerksplanung Energetische Sanierung Turnhalle Sekundarschule
Procedure title: Tragwerksplanung Energetische Sanierung Turnhalle Sekundarschule
Description: Die Gemeinde Reken beabsichtigt die energetische Sanierung und funktionale Modernisierung der Sporthalle an der Sekundarschule Hohe Mark in Reken. Die Halle ist ein zentraler Bestandteil der schulischen, gemeindlichen und vereinsbezogenen Sportinfrastruktur und soll energetisch verbessert, funktional modernisiert und langfristig für den Schul-, Vereins- und Breitensport gesichert werden. Gegenstand des Auftrags sind die für das Vorhaben erforderlichen Ingenieurleistungen zum Leistungsbild Fachplanung Tragwerksplanung. Insgesamt umfasst die Vergabe die Leistungsphasen 1 bis 6 sowie besondere Leistungen zur Leistungsphase 8. Eine stufenweise Beauftragung findet nicht statt.
Lot description: Gegenstand des Auftrags sind die Ingenieurleistungen zum Leistungsbild Fachplanung Tragwerksplanung für das oben kurz beschriebene und in der Leistungsbeschreibung näher erläuterte Bauvorhaben "Energetische Sanierung Turnhalle Sekundarschule". Der Auftrag umfasst alle Leistungsphasen für das genannte Leistungsbild. Eine stufenweise Beauftragung findet nicht statt. Neben den weitgehend übertragenen Grundleistungen werden ausgewählte besondere Leistungen übertragen. Das Nähere regelt die Leistungsbeschreibung.
